links.outcome: Hallucination detection rates of automated verification on LLM-generated report outputs
links.effect: Hallucination detection rates over 83% for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications; 30% reduction in report creation time
links.quote: Evaluation shows hallucination detection rates of over 83% for structured entities and 72% for semantic fabrications, with a 30% reduction in report creation time, demonstrating that neuro-symbolic architectures can provide principled safeguards for LLM deployment in data-sensitive domains.

unlisted_practices: Neuro-symbolic hybrid verification combining logical input verification with embedding-based semantic similarity output validation in a parallel actor-based pipeline

screen.reason: The study evaluates a neuro-symbolic verification guardrail pipeline applied to LLM-generated reports in a medical device damage assessment system, measuring hallucination detection rates and efficiency gains.
